Calculate the thermal-mismatch strain in the aluminum film using the formula epsilon_mismatch = (alpha_f - alpha_s) * Delta_T.
Use alpha_f = 23 x 10^-6 K^-1 for the aluminum film.
Use alpha_s = 8 x 10^-6 K^-1 for the ceramic substrate.
Use Delta_T = -180 K to represent the 180 K cooling.
Report the magnitude of the mismatch strain as the final estimate, and note that the strain is compressive in the film because the aluminum has a higher CTE and is constrained by the substrate during cooling.
